description: This Java class 'MerchantConfigurationDaoImpl' implements data access operations for MerchantConfiguration entities, including fetching configurations based on key, store, and type. It interacts with a database using QueryDSL and extends a generic DAO implementation.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of DAO for MerchantConfiguration, providing methods to retrieve configurations by key, store, and type.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches a single MerchantConfiguration based on a key and store.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves all MerchantConfigurations associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MerchantConfigurations filtered by configuration type and store.
